description: Bounded internal center/preschool directory acquisition with paired client continuity and selected-only retention.
redirect_policy: Reject every redirect; fixed client GET and empty-form pins POST only.
retry: No retries or automatic refresh. Changed client, denied access or invalid response requires review.
checkpoint: Await selected-only durable checkpoints before subsequent requests. Manifest last; retained evidence replay is offline.
idempotency: Unique release ID and source ordinal preserve repeated rows; source ordinals are not stable provider identities. Reuse completed releases downstream.
cancellation: Abort and drain bounded transport; await cooperative checkpoint completion before returning. Never publish a cancelled incomplete release.
retention_profile: Center/preschool whitelist only; mixed response discarded. No public export.
